issue_context.title: Make the View > Preview > Brush Preview a global preference
issue_context.body:
It was an option created for each document, but we can convert it to a global option.

Source: https://steamcommunity.com/app/431730/discussions/0/599638390296547751/
comments: Hi @dacap ! I wanted to ask if i could work on this issue ^^?
Hi @S4HRKBOY! Sure you can continue with it!

Hi @dacap  i opened a PR and moved the option from the DocPref to the Global Pref under the editor category.
![Screenshot from 2024-12-11 21-38-04](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8350199b-ac69-4907-b35f-91c6c56c9a87)

I think we can leave the menu option in _View > Preview > Brush Preview_. About the option in Preferences, I'm not sure if this should be on `Editor` or `Cursors`. Anyway I think we have to keep the menu option.

For my Understanding do you want: 

1. An Option in Preferences (under `Cursor`) as a global setting **AND** the additional option in the _View > Preview > Brush Preview_ . When one of these is checked the pen preview will be rendered. **OR**:
2. Only the option inside _View > Preview > Brush Preview_ which will be used as a global Setting?

Hi @dacap! I updated my PR to also include both options (I am not sure if this was your intended way tho). 1st There is now a global preference under `Cursor` and the already implemented option under View > Preview > Brush Preview. The pen preview will be rendered when 1 of these options are turned on.

Hi @S4HRKBOY, sorry for my late response in this one. I used and amend your commit from the PR to simplify the code and just converting the option from "per document" to a global option (check the merged commit 8d30a18ed5eb269981cd7a53ce9f36a3fc902b4f). So basically _View > Preview > Brush Preview_ changes this global option. I didn't add the _Edit > Preferences_ changes just to keep it simply, but we could add that in a future if users start asking about it (IMO this is only for users that want the old behavior, but new users will be used to the new behavior without the brush preview).
